profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Twilio
profile.summary:
Major in Industrial Engineering and minor in Computer Science at Georgia Tech.

Highly-energetic and self-motivated, able to produce quality results under pressure while maintaining a strong work ethic. 
Balanced skills include Data Analytics, Software Development, Project Management, Inventory Management, Logistics, and Supply Chain.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Migration from on-prem to Cloud:
● Impact: saved $353M at-risk revenue annually
● Instead of end-of-life on-prem service, designed shim endpoints to continue
supporting on-prem users and their resources even after migration.
● Shim endpoints allow on-prem users to continue their workflows without
changing their UI or API interactions. To support both on-prem users and
migrated users during migration phase, built a proxy server that decides the
routing based on each user’s migration status.

positions.title: Software Engineer L2
positions.description:
Product Recommendations:
● Impact: Generated $3.43M in attached ARR and enabled the launch of a new
premium package with AI feature. Customers reported over 400% increase in ROI.
● Co-authored the design doc for Product Recommendations that use Machine
Learning model to recommend products based on user’s interactions with
websites or apps.
● Built data processing pipeline to process user interactions data and products data
for all customers that use Segment to collect real-time user data and to send
them to ML model.

Scaling Project Blueprint and Building Infrastructure for Scalability:
● Impact: Supported scaling from 1 billion to 8.5 billion. Improved query speed by
reducing per-pod data size and using smaller, more efficient Snowflake
warehouses. Reduced costs on Snowflake warehouse size.
● Designed the system on how to allocate users to a pod, how to forward requests
downstream, and how to manage users' data across pods.
● Created resources and infrastructures needed for the scaling project. Set up API
Gateway, a serverless function, datastore, and other infrastructures using
Terraform to implement the scaling project.

positions.title: Georgia Tech Senior Capstone Project Consultant
positions.description:
o Providing Insights with data-driven KPIs:
Built data driven metrics to keep track of their performance in regard to inventory management. These metrics helped to create a more accurate picture and holistic understanding of the distribution to the retailers.

o Inventory Management:
Drove implementation of the Order Recommendation Tool using Excel VBA. This tool aimed to provide more accurate order quantities by taking into account considerations, such as historical sales and presentation quantity. It fundamentally helped prevent over-ordering and under-ordering from retailers.

o Shortage Allocation: 
Built an optimization model to maintain high service level across retailers in the event of a shortage. Prioritized the stores and allocated different quantities based on a variety of constraints, such as historical sales, current inventory level, and regionality. This model is backed by a Gurobi Python code and there was 5-10% increase in service level per retailer.

positions.title: Data Analyst Co-op in Reporting & Analytics
positions.description:
o Operation Reporting: 
Built monthly performance review reports using SQL in SAS that analyze customer satisfaction scores of 200 million passengers each year, flight delays, and flight cancellation patterns pertaining to maintenance issues.

o Aircraft Maintenance Tableau Dashboard: 
Utilizing 20+ data sources and SQL in SAS, I implemented color-coded system to note maintenance status for 915 individual aircraft and further analyzed the main causes of deferred tasks. Improved the communication process between the resource planner and maintenance technicians.

o KPI Tableau Dashboard: 
Communicated trends of the fundamental performance measure, including ‘Aircraft Out-of-Service’ and ‘Departure on time’ for 5000+ daily flights on Tableau to help business units to plan accordingly ahead of time.

positions.title: ACT instructor
positions.description:
o  1-1 Tutoring:
Helps to improve high school students' performance and to enhance their problem-solving skills with practical real-world examples.

positions.title: Academic consultant
positions.description:
o Consulting:
Analyzes students’ strengths and weaknesses and consults high school students and their parents on college admission
